online_softmax.finding: Online softmax matches materialized attention while avoiding the full SxS probability matrix; the CPU loop is slower here because it prioritizes algorithm shape over fused-kernel speed.

triton.reason: Fused Triton attention requires a CUDA-visible device.
triton.boundary: Session 18 proves online softmax semantics on CPU; Session 07 and a CUDA runtime are needed for GPU fused-kernel timing.

correctness.note: Online attention output is compared against materialized torch.softmax(QK^T)V for each sequence length.

boundary: This lab teaches the core FlashAttention-style online softmax recurrence with measured CPU artifacts. It does not claim fused GPU speed without a CUDA-visible device.
